blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 22 sold over 5 months against an average of 29.2 listed, about 6.6 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was June with 7 sold. blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: streets and boundaries

items.t: Hammond adjoins it to the south-west and has its own area plan, updated in the same November 25, 2025 OCP package.

The Hammond plan states Hammond sits in the south-west corner of Maple Ridge, bounded west by Pitt Meadows and the Katzie First Nation and south by the Fraser River — the same river edge that shapes this area's south side.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: the housing stock

items.t: Zoning minimums that are confirmed from the bylaw schedule: RS-2 at 0.4 hectares, RS-3 at 0.8 or 2.0 hectares, and agricultural zones A-1 at 2.0 hectares, A-2 at 4.0 hectares and A-3 at 8.0 hectares.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: rules that affect buyers

items.t: The Hammond Area Plan directs growth around Maple Meadows Station and allows 8–12 storey mixed-use near transit while protecting employment lands — the rule set on this area's south-west edge.
Wharf Street in Lower Hammond serves as both road and dike, and homes on the Fraser River side of it do not get the dike's flood protection — a title-and-survey check for any river-edge lot.

Maple Ridge Floodplain Management Bylaw No. 8121-2026 designates flood hazard areas and connected riverine hazard areas, and bars new buildings outside dike protection in a connected riverine area unless a site-specific exemption is granted.
A secondary suite is not permitted on a floodplain property unless the underside of the suite's finished floor system is above the flood construction level.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: One named elementary school for this area is in a different municipality: Davie Jones Elementary is in Pitt Meadows, not Maple Ridge, even though SD42 serves both cities.
The Hammond plan records that Lower Hammond has fewer mature trees than Upper Hammond, which it links to lower elevation and drainage — a visible clue to which lots sit low.
SD42 does not list Hammond-area catchments among its regular school-bus catchments, so most west-side students are not on a district bus route.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: development and new projects

items.t: A new Protective Services Building in West Maple Ridge is starting construction under the adopted 2026–2030 Capital Plan.
Abernethy Way is being extended from 232 Street to 240 Street, east of this area, to improve east–west flow and prepare for future bus rapid transit on Lougheed Highway.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: costs and taxes

items.t: The area-specific cost split is municipal: a Pitt Meadows address and a Maple Ridge address on adjoining streets carry different city tax notices, even inside one school district.
Maple Ridge metered water and sewer customers moved to seasonal metered rates on January 1, 2026, with the former sewer parcel tax folded into the sewer rate.
Maple Meadows Station is the west-side West Coast Express station, on the weekday Waterfront to Mission City commuter line.
Haney Place Exchange carries the R3 Lougheed Highway RapidBus to Coquitlam Central Station.

The Pitt Meadows/Maple Ridge Diking District's east edge is a rise of land in Maple Ridge at approximately 201 Street and the Canadian Pacific Railway alignment — the same corridor the west-side roads and rail crossings use.

blocks.text: Northwest Maple Ridge: risks and due diligence

items.t: Start with the dike question: the diking district covers 410 hectares in Maple Ridge, bounded by the Fraser, Pitt and Alouette River dikes, and a lot's position relative to the dike decides its protection.
Then check the floodplain bylaw map: land less than 1.5 metres above the natural boundary of an adjacent watercourse is designated floodplain under Bylaw No. 8121-2026.

faq.a: Two Maple Ridge schools are confirmed by name and address, plus one across the city line. Fairview Elementary is at 12209 206 Street and Laity View Elementary at 21023 123 Avenue in Maple Ridge, while Davie Jones Elementary at 12030 Blakely Road sits in Pitt Meadows; SD42 catchments are address-based, so run the exact address in the district locator before relying on any one school.
faq.q: Which elementary schools serve the west side?

faq.a: Westview Secondary is the west-side secondary named in district records. It sits at 20905 Wicklund Avenue in Maple Ridge, and SD42 runs secondary as Grades 8 to 12 with no middle tier; as with elementary schools, the catchment is decided by the exact home address in the SD42 locator, not by the neighbourhood name alone.
faq.q: Which secondary school serves Northwest Maple Ridge?

faq.a: The west-side roads feed the bridge corridor through Pitt Meadows and the Lougheed corridor. Maple Meadows Station on the West Coast Express and Haney Place Exchange with the R3 RapidBus are the transit anchors for this side of the city, and TransLink's Langley–Haney Place bus rapid transit line is in detailed planning between Willowbrook and Haney Place.
